modelDescription: The XPR is a relatively new rifle from Winchester Repeating Arms, but it has already been called "the best of the best," and "a class leader," by Field and Stream and American Hunter respectively. Watch this video and get a feel for why this is no ordinary "value" rifle. It is simply a lot of great features packed into an affordable, very accurate package.
